A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[landspeeder]] '''driver''' drove around [[Pantora]] at the beginning of the [[Imperial Era]]. When the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] and the [[Youngling|child]] [[Cloning|clone]], [[Omega]], dropped onto a [[Speeder truck|hovertruck]], a [[Chase on Pantora|chase]] then occurred between Shand and [[Hunter]]. During the chase, Omega pulled the dump lever on the hovertruck, causing the bed to rise. This then caused Shand to fall onto a [[ComfortRide passenger airspeeder|ComfortRide Passenger Airspeeder]] that this human was driving. Unbeknownst that Shand was still holding on to the [[airspeeder]], the [[assassin]] knocked out the driver as she tossed him out of the vehicle.<ref name="Cornered" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The human landspeeder driver first appeared in "[[Cornered]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. He was voiced by [[Taran Killam]].<ref name="Cornered" />
